'''Deep Storage Bay V14''' was a storage bay on [[Sel Zonn Station]].

==History==
The storage bay was occupied by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]] [[Switch]], who ran his organization from it. It was located on a level of the station with restricted access and Switch bribed the station's manager to keep it quarantined. A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] once went there to negotiate with Switch for the release of some cargo and while they were there, they were attacked by [[Ganga Lor]] and his thugs.
